text: Assumption: The application is always obligated to actively check the validity status of the snapshot after GetTimeWithStatus() before measured values are used for safety-critical control loops — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The application is always obligated to actively check the validity status of the snapshot after GetTimeWithStatus() before measured values are used for safety-critical control loops — is this correct?

assumption: The application is always obligated to actively check the validity status of the snapshot after GetTimeWithStatus() before measured values are used for safety-critical control loops.
rationale: SWS_TS_01050 and SWS_TS_01403 represent timeout and loss of synchronization as status flags in the snapshot instead of enforcing exceptions.

original.text: Annahme: Interpretation: Die Applikation dürfte stets in der Pflicht stehen, nach GetTimeWithStatus() den Gültigkeitsstatus des Snapshots aktiv zu prüfen, bevor Messwerte für sicherheitskritische Regelschleifen herangezogen werden — trifft das zu?

original.rationale: SWS_TS_01050 und SWS_TS_01403 bilden Timeout- und Synchronisationsverluste als Statusflags im Snapshot ab, statt Ausnahmen zu erzwingen.
